outcome: Diagnosis and management of gestational hypertension
Management of chronic hypertension in pregnancy
Screening for hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
Prevention of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
Long-term maternal health risks related to hypertensive disorders
finding: This guideline provides an updated evidence-based clinical approach to the diagnosis, management, screening, and prevention of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and discusses their recurrence risks and long-term maternal health implications.
